mapper.select: SELECT bracket_id AS bracketId, tax_rate AS taxRate, progressive_deduction AS progressiveDeduction FROM gift_tax_bracket WHERE effective_from <= #{baseDate} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{baseDate}) AND lower_bound < #{taxableBase} AND (upper_bound IS NULL OR #{taxableBase} <= upper_bound) LIMIT 1

SELECT s.family_id, sp.simul_result_id FROM simulation s JOIN family f ON f.family_id = s.family_id JOIN simulation_portfolio sp ON sp.simul_portfolio_id = s.selected_portfolio_id WHERE s.simul_id = #{simulationId} AND f.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'SAVED'

SELECT tranche_id, simul_result_id AS result_id, sequence_no, gift_date, gift_amount, estimated_gift_tax, donor_required_amount, investment_amount, created_at FROM simulation_tranche WHERE simul_result_id = #{simulResultId} ORDER BY sequence_no
